source: OECD Inter-Country Input-Output (ICIO) tables, 2023 edition, 2020 table (2020_SML.csv)
recipe: six final-demand categories -> C (HFCE+NPISH+GGFC), I (GFCF+INVNT), Cx (DPABR)
net taxes of intermediate columns = sales - purchases - value added (residual)
legacy_defects_not_reproduced: Agregar_11s.m wrote ROW's final-demand sales to the other countries into intermediate columns (data7fd loop writes into data7) and left the ROW final-demand block empty
Agregar_11s.m wrote the tax/VA cells of ROW's final-demand columns into ROW's flow rows (data5Tfd loop writes into data5fd) and left those cells empty
